title: Roof replacement
summary: Tear-off to deck, new underlayment, flashing and ventilation, and a shingle roof built for a wet Oregon winter.
tagline: Tear-off to the deck, built new

image.alt: Roofer nailing new architectural shingles over synthetic underlayment

title: Roof repair
summary: Leaks, lifted or missing shingles, failed flashing and storm damage, found at the source and fixed to match.

image.alt: Roofer standing on a section of roof opened up for repair

title: Roof maintenance
summary: Moss treatment, debris clearing and a close inspection, so small problems are caught before they reach the ceiling.

image.alt: Moss growing along the courses of a shingle roof around a skylight

title: Gutter systems
summary: Seamless gutters and downspouts sized for Northwest rain, pitched to drain and hung to carry the load.

image.alt: Seamless aluminum gutter with its outlet, elbows and downspout

title: Commercial roofing
summary: Single-ply and low-slope systems for shops, warehouses and light-industrial buildings, detailed at every curb and drain.

image.alt: White membrane roof with rooftop units on a commercial building

title: Multi-unit roofing
summary: Apartments, condos and townhome rows, planned building by building around the people living underneath.

image.alt: Aerial view of rows of townhomes with gray shingle roofs
